description: Rothco’s MOLLE Compatible 18-Inch Machete Sheath is the ultimate solution for safely transporting your machete during outdoor adventures. Constructed from durable yet lightweight polyester, this machete sheath is designed for long-lasting use. The sheath features multiple carry options, including 2 D-rings and four MOLLE straps, allowing you to attach it to various gear configurations securely. Inside, a sturdy plastic reinforcement ensures that your machete is held securely and remains protected. A tight snap loop fits around the machete handle, holding it firmly in place as you hike, camp, or explore the wilderness. With Rothco’s MOLLE Compatible Machete Sheath, you have a reliable and versatile tool to enhance your outdoor experience.
